sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Compiler settings for shared types
sections.what: Sets the source and output folders, includes all source files, and turns composite off.
sections.watch_out: Composite is off, so project references between packages will not work from this file.

summary: TypeScript settings for the shared types package, built on the root base settings.
purpose: Tells the compiler where the source and output folders are and which files to check.
why: Likely reason: keeps the package in line with the monorepo base settings.
how: Extends the root base file, sets the source and output folders, includes all TypeScript files under src, and excludes the output folder.
inputs: The root base tsconfig file, which is not in the packet, and the files under src.
outputs: Type check results and build output in the dist folder.
risks: The base file it extends is not in the packet, so its effect cannot be confirmed. The package lists a tsconfig package as a dependency, but this file does not use it.
debug: If typecheck fails, check the root base file and the source folder path.
